coverage_boundary: Covers exactly the 177 changed-reference and 36 new Go implementation entries from the P3 checkpoint ledger. New tests, skills, docs and evaluation files not in that ledger are dependencies and still need their owning gate; this is not complete-repository diff approval. Apps three follow-up blobs supersede their checkpoint blobs for semantic review.

evidence.tested_revision: tested immutable revision or explicitly unbound

prior_review_note: No independent whole-file semantic approval with exact source hash and reviewer verdict has been recorded in these evidence files. Resolved Apps scope/storage findings and independent test recounts are useful evidence but are not approvals of every changed line.
